conversion_policy: Prices, sizes and timestamps are exact; nothing is rounded. Source publisher and instrument IDs are kept; the channel is the source channel_id, or 0 when the file has none. NWT sequences restart at 1 per (publisher, channel); the source sequence number is not carried. Source flags are not carried. Every row -> BEST_QUOTE, event-driven (interval_ns 0). bid_publisher_id and ask_publisher_id are the source's venue IDs for each side, 0 on an absent side. Every ID is declared in the manifest as publisher-<id>. The source has no order counts: a present side has a null count. Trade rows restate the best quote under the publisher of the row; the trade print itself is not carried by this kind. Each instrument's definition comes from the venue's definition file and is written before its first record.
